sentence: Someone who made a project asks their AI assistant once, answers a few questions, and gets a GitHub front page that explains itself: plain text and moving pictures, in dark and light, in their own colours.

unfinished.item: the sentence about plan.json uses the word 'planned' as a verb, not an unfinished feature

shows: your project folder
jano mark station
parcel carrying the project
finished readme page with a moving banner
section pictures arriving on the page

picture.claim: The finished front page has a moving picture on top, a picture for the parts that need one, short plain text, and both a dark and a light version.
shows: one large front page zoomed in
its parts lit one at a time
a card naming the lit part
a dark and light switch
a pointer that clicks the switch
the page turning light

picture.claim: It suits very different projects, a book app, a writing style for AI and a web tool for AI, and each gets its own picture in its own colours.
shows: three small front pages side by side
a grey banner on each turning into the project's own colours
a book with a lock becoming an epub file
a long reply shrinking to a short one
a robot, a wall and a globe
a parcel from the jano mark landing in each banner
a kind label under each page

picture.claim: You type one request in your assistant's chat, pick an answer to a few questions with a click, and it carries on alone until the front page is ready.
shows: a chat window
the typed request
a question with two answer buttons
a pointer clicking an answer
two answer dots filling
a done message

icons.why: The Jano mark is a thick door outline with round corners and a solid dot; Phosphor bold draws with the same heavy, round-cornered stroke and little detail.
